verdict.rationale: Lium is a GPU rental marketplace, and a buyer could reasonably ask such a platform for AI-generated insights on usage or spend, so the axis applies. The evidence shows non-AI spend reporting (burn per hour, spend per pod, runway), GPU performance scoring, and an MCP server for searching docs and prices. None of these is an in-product feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from the user's own data, so none earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
